# Divider

A line that separates content, with or without a label.

```tsx
import { Divider } from '@kafka/react'
```

## When to use it

- To split two groups that belong to the same page: sections of a form, "o continúa con".
- Vertical between inline items such as "Taller | Poesía | Jueves".

## When not to

- As spacing: use space, not a line.
- Between every item of a list: whitespace is quieter.

## Examples

### Horizontal

A real `<hr>`: screen readers announce a separator.

```tsx
<div className="max-w-xl">
  <p>Primer bloque</p>
  <Divider className="my-4" />
  <p>Segundo bloque</p>
</div>
```

### With a label

The text is read as normal content; the two rules are hidden from assistive technology.

```tsx
<div className="max-w-xl"><Divider label="o continúa con" /></div>
```

### Vertical and decorative

`decorative` removes the separator role when the line only adds ornament.

```tsx
<div className="flex h-8 items-center gap-4">
  <span>Taller</span>
  <Divider orientation="vertical" />
  <span>Poesía</span>
  <Divider orientation="vertical" decorative />
  <span>Jueves</span>
</div>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `orientation` | `'horizontal' \| 'vertical'` | `'horizontal'` |  |
| `label` | `ReactNode` |  | Text between two rules ("o continúa con"). Horizontal only. |
| `decorative` | `boolean` | `false` | The line is ornament only: it is not announced as a separator. |
| …rest | `HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>` | | Everything else is passed to the underlying element. |

## Accessibility

- **A real `<hr>`** when horizontal, so screen readers announce a separator. `decorative` removes the role when the line only adds ornament.
- With a `label` the two rules are hidden from assistive technology and the text is read as normal content.
- The rule is decorative contrast-wise (1 px, `border.default`); the meaning never depends on seeing it.

## Content

- Labels are two or three words in lower case: "o continúa con".
